answer: An agent registers by locking a locked liquidity-pool share as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. The network catches grading peers far from the panel verdict through consensus scoring of grades. Conviction means the full bond is burned on the spot. The ledger keeps every bond inside a zephyr the owner cannot hide. A canyon that shares its bond with another identity is cut at once. No atlas means no registration: the bond comes first.
